A content pack is the unit of reference material the app installs. The same format is used for data bundled inside the app and for packs downloaded later from a server.

Each pack carries a signed manifest and a payload. The payload is a SQLite database holding works, sections, passages and the chunks the assistant retrieves from.

Bundled packs are not encrypted, because any key shipped inside the app could be read by anyone with the app. Downloaded packs are encrypted with a key that is unique to the pack revision and wrapped for each device.

यह एक परीक्षण दस्तावेज़ है। इसका उपयोग केवल स्वचालित परीक्षणों में होता है।
